description: Source code for MojoVideoEncodeAcceleratorProvider class, implementing creation and management of video encode accelerators with GPU preferences and threading support.

classes.name: MojoVideoEncodeAcceleratorProvider
classes.description: Provides video encode acceleration services, manages creation of encoders, and supports querying supported profiles.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a MojoVideoEncodeAcceleratorProvider instance, posting the task to a thread pool if enabled.

methods.name: GetVideoEncodeAcceleratorSupportedProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves supported video encode profiles based on GPU preferences and workarounds.

methods.name: CreateVideoEncodeAccelerator
methods.description: Creates a video encode accelerator and posts the creation task to a thread pool if feature flag is enabled.
